revision: S3/P7: schematic S3 adds GATE IN (J6, NPN gate buffer -> PB2, TN jack detect -> PB1: patched = MIDI notes bypassed). Placement P7 (user, 2026-10-28): GATE IN + MIDI IN in the top row, ENV OUT + MIDI OUT in the bottom row (inputs over outputs, X7 / X23), ENV LED D8 between them next to ENV OUT; J3 power moved off the REC row (a 16-pin socket would cover the MIDI OUT pads) to the right edge between the pots, vertical on B, pin 1 (-12 V) at the bottom. P6: ENV LED next to ENV OUT, J4 UPDI to the left edge. SMD parked off the board, nothing routed. R1 (2026-10-28): SMD placed and routed on the board (research.md 4); the native PCB owns SMD placement and copper.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Doepfer A-100 6HP: 30.0 mm wide; single hole pair at X12.58 (both rails) as modules/hats, modules/low and modules/16bit. Skiff rails: clear Y8.0..120.5.

main_pcb.note: 29.0 x 110.0 mm (as modules/hats and modules/low), 1.25 mm inside the rail gap at each end; held by the three jack nuts (RV09 pots take no nut). 1 mm edge keep-out (root AGENTS.md): every courtyard >= 1.0 mm from the outline. Layer count is decided at routing (2 layers planned; 4 if the SMD does not fit).

panel_order: Top to bottom: GATE IN + MIDI IN; ATTACK; RELEASE; MODE button + HR / AR / ASR LEDs in one row; REC button + REC LED; ENV OUT + ENV LED + MIDI OUT at the bottom (inputs over outputs).
layout_note: 6HP leaves 27.0 mm between the 1 mm edge keep-outs: jack columns X7 / X23 (16 mm pitch) in both jack rows, so the ENV LED fits between the bottom jacks (X14.5, next to ENV OUT); pots in the centre column X15, ATTACK Y36.5 / RELEASE Y66.5 (30 mm pitch); buttons on the left (X6.5) with the mode LEDs (5.5 mm pitch) / REC LED to their right; J3 power (B, vertical) on the right edge between the pots, J4 UPDI (B) on the left edge between the pots.

jacks.role: MIDI OUT (passive thru, wired to J1)

pot_part: Song Huei R0904N (user stock 50k linear), vertical snap-in, no bushing, no nut, on the Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint (as modules/acid)
led_note: 3 mm THT on F at rotation 0 (pads side by side, anode pad 2 on the right), placed by the pad centre = body centre; dome flush with the panel front as modules/8bit (model Z +3.3).
button_note: Generic 6 x 6 mm THT tact (7 mm), stock SW_PUSH_6mm_H7.3mm on F, placed by the pad-pattern centre = stem centre, rot 180 (pad 1 signal on the bottom row) as modules/acid; pressed through the panel by the modules/8bit printed cap.

stack_Z_mm.note: As modules/8bit (LED dome flush with the 1.6 mm FR4 panel front).

power_header.orientation: Vertical on B on the right board edge between the pots (P7): pin 1/2 (-12 V) in the bottom row Y56.58, odd pins in the left column X23.8, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the top Y46.42. Moved from the REC row because a socket there covers the MIDI OUT pads (P7 bottom-right jack). Columns 0.3 mm right of P6 so the socket envelope (X >= 21.27) clears the pot lug pads (X <= 21.16).
power_header.idc_note: A 10- or 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the bottom); 16-pin positions 11-16 overhang upwards (to Y35.0) over the free right strip between the pots, clear of every B-side pad. Envelope = socket body 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres along the header, 2.53 mm across. B-side SMD placed under it later must stay <= 2 mm tall.

back_side_tht.note: vertical on the right edge between the pots, pin 1 (-12 V) bottom left
UPDI on the left board edge between the pots, vertical (pin 1 UPDI on top at Y50.23, pin 2 GND Y52.77); centre column left free for the MCU

smd_parking.note: Every SMD part waits here, off the board edge, in reference order; it moves onto the board with its functional group (root AGENTS.md divide and conquer).
